# Function to get indicies of files matching protein + cell state condition
```{r}
get_index <- function(metadata, protein, cell){
  
  m <- metadata[metadata$protein %in% protein & metadata$cell %in% cell, ] # Select rows of metadata df
  return (as.vector(m$file)) # Get ix of those row
  
}
```


# Functions to calculate baseline and AUC
```{r}
# Calculate baseline (avg(signal) for the first X time points)
get_baseline <- function(df, nrows){ # Input df and nrows used to calc avg
  return (mean(df$V2[1:nrows]))
}

# Calculate AUC of curve from specifeid time range (t1 & t2) and subtract area under baseline
get_AUC <- function(df, t1, t2, baseline_range){
  
  baseline <- get_baseline(df, baseline_range) # Get baseline
  
  # Select range
  df_filt <- df[df$V1 >= t1 & df$V1 <= t2, ]
  df_filt$V2 <- df_filt$V2 - baseline
  
  auc <- auc(df_filt$V1, df_filt$V2) # Calcualte AUC
  
  return (round(auc,3))
}
```



# Read in dfs, add AUC
```{r}
merge_dfs <- function(metadata, protein, cell, path, baseline_range, t1, t2){
  
   # Get index of files of interest
  ix <- get_index(metadata, protein, cell)
  
  dfs <- list()
  for (i in ix) {
    filepath <- list.files(path, pattern = paste0(i, ".dx_FLD1A.CSV$"), full.names = TRUE)
    df <- read.csv(filepath, header=FALSE)
    
    # Add AUC to df
    df$AUC <- get_AUC(df, t1, t2, baseline_range)
    
    # Add metadata info
    cell_type <- metadata[metadata$file == i, ]$cell
    df$cell <- cell_type
    df$protein <- protein
    
    # Add label to use for plotting
    df$label <- paste(cell_type, " ", i,": ", get_AUC(df, t1, t2, baseline_range), sep="")
    
    dfs[[paste0("df", i)]] <- df
  
  }
  
  dfs_all <- do.call(rbind, dfs)
  
  return(dfs_all)
  
}
  
```

Function to process excel sheet with single protein measurements
```{r}

baseline_AUC <- function(df, t1, t2, column, baseline_nrows){
  
  df <- df[c('Time',column)]
  
  # Get baseline value
  baseline <- mean(df[[column]][1:baseline_nrows])
  
  df_filt <- df[df$Time >= t1 & df$Time <= t2, ]
  df_filt[[column]] <- df_filt[[column]] - baseline
  auc <- auc(df_filt$Time, df_filt[[column]])
  
  df$AUC <- round(auc,3)
  df$Label <- paste(column,": ", round(auc,3), sep="")
  
  names(df)[names(df) == column] <- 'Response'
  
  return (df)
}

```

# Plotting function
```{r}
lineplot_one_track <- function(df, t1, t2, expi, vulko, baseline_nrows, out_path){
  
  df_expi <- baseline_AUC(df, t1, t2, expi, baseline_nrows)
  df_vulko <- baseline_AUC(df, t1, t2, vulko, baseline_nrows)
  
  df_merged <- rbind(df_expi, df_vulko)
  
  y_label <- max(df_merged$Response)/1.5
  AUC_ratio <- round(df_vulko$AUC[1]/df_expi$AUC[1],3) # Calc Vulko/Expi AUC ratio
  protein <- sub("_Expi$", "", expi)
  title <- paste0(protein, " - Vulko Expi AUC ratio: ", AUC_ratio) # Add ratio Vulko/Expi AUC to title
  
  my_colors <- c("#6db550", "#565c94")
  
  pdf(paste0(out_path, protein,"_no_rep.pdf"), width=8, height = 4)
  
  gg <- ggplot(df_merged, aes(x = Time, y = Response, color = Label)) +
    geom_line() +
    labs(title = title,
         x = "Retention time [min]",
         y = "Response [LU]",
         color = "AUC in range") +
    annotate("text", x = t1, y = y_label, label = paste0("T1 = ", t1,"\n"), size = 4, color = "#9e9e9e", angle=90) +
    annotate("text", x = t2, y = y_label, label = paste0("\n","T2 = ", t2), size = 4, color = "#9e9e9e", angle=90) +
    geom_vline(xintercept=t1, linetype="dashed", color="gray", linewidth=0.5) +
    geom_vline(xintercept=t2, linetype="dashed", color="gray", linewidth=0.5) +
    scale_color_manual(values = my_colors) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 14, hjust = 0.5),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 13),    
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 13),   
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),    
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 9),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 9)
    )
  
  print(gg)  
  
  dev.off()
}


```

Funcion to generate single lineplots
```{r}
single_lineplot <- function(protein, cell, metadata, data_path, out_path, t1, t2, baseline_range){

  # For plotting fSec curves
  dfs_fSec <- merge_dfs(metadata, protein, cell, data_path, baseline_range, t1, t2)

  # For plotting barplots
  df_AUCs <- unique(dfs_fSec[, c("label", "AUC", "cell", "protein")])
  
  # fSec plot
  my_colors <- c("#6db550", "#a5de8e", "#3d8f31", "#c0bbf9", "#8896c8", "#565c94")
  y_label <- max(dfs_fSec$V2)/1.5
  
  pdf(paste0(out_path, protein,"_fSec_single.pdf"), width=8, height = 4)
  
  gg <- ggplot(dfs_fSec, aes(x = V1, y = V2, color = label)) +
    geom_line() +
    labs(title = protein,
         x = "Retention time [min]",
         y = "Response [LU]",
         color = "AUC in range") +
    annotate("text", x = t1, y = y_label, label = paste0("T1 = ", t1,"\n"), size = 4, color = "#9e9e9e", angle=90) +
    annotate("text", x = t2, y = y_label, label = paste0("\n","T2 = ", t2), size = 4, color = "#9e9e9e", angle=90) +
    geom_vline(xintercept=t1, linetype="dashed", color="gray", linewidth=0.5) +
    geom_vline(xintercept=t2, linetype="dashed", color="gray", linewidth=0.5) +
    scale_color_manual(values = my_colors) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 14, hjust = 0.5),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 13),    
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 13),   
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),    
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 14),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 12)
    )
  print(gg)
  
  dev.off()  
  
}

```

# ############################################################################################################
# PLOT WITH SD SHADOW
# ############################################################################################################

Merge dataframes on time columns
```{r}
merge_times <- function(dfs) {
  
  merged_df <- Reduce(function(x, y) {
    t_x <- grep("^Time", names(x), value = TRUE)[1]
    t_y <- grep("^Time", names(y), value = TRUE)[1]
    
    merge(x, y, by.x = t_x, by.y = t_y, all = FALSE)
  }, dfs)
  
  # Rename time column
  names(merged_df)[grepl("^Time", names(merged_df))] <- "Time"
  
  return(merged_df)
}
```

Read in csv files & set first measuring point to t=0
```{r}
merge_dfs_time <- function(metadata, protein, cell, data_path){
  
  # Get ix of files to read in
  ix <- get_index(metadata, protein, cell)
  
  dfs <- list()
  for (i in ix) {
    
    # Read in
    filepath <- list.files(data_path, pattern = paste0(i, ".dx_FLD1A.CSV$"), full.names = TRUE)
    df <- read.csv(filepath, header=FALSE)
    
    # Reset times
    df$V1 <- df$V1 - df$V1[1]
    df$V1 <- round(df$V1, 9)
    
    # Rename columns
    colnames(df) <- c(paste0("Time_", i), paste0(protein, "_", i))
    dfs[[paste0("df", i)]] <- df
  }
  
  # Mere dataframes
  merged_dfs <- merge_times(dfs)
  
  # Get average and SD values
  merged_dfs$AVG <- rowMeans(merged_dfs[, grepl(protein, names(merged_dfs))])
  merged_dfs$SD <- apply(merged_dfs[, grepl(protein, names(merged_dfs))], 1, sd)
  
  # Add cell line info
  merged_dfs$cell_line <- cell
  
  merged_dfs <- select(merged_dfs, Time, AVG, SD, cell_line)

  return(merged_dfs)
}
```


# Plotting ufnciton lineplots wihd std shadow
```{r}
lineplot_sds <- function(protein, metadata, data_path, out_path, t1, t2){

  df_vulko <- merge_dfs_time(metadata, protein, "Vulko", data_path)
  df_expi <- merge_dfs_time(metadata, protein, "Expi293", data_path)
  
  combined_df <- rbind(df_vulko, df_expi)
  
  # Set y location for t1, t2 label placement
  y_label <- max((combined_df$AVG)/1.5)
  
  # SAve plot
  pdf(paste0(out_path, protein,"_fSec.pdf"), width=8, height = 4)
  
  gg <- ggplot(combined_df, aes(x = Time, y = AVG, color = cell_line, fill = cell_line)) +
    geom_line(size = 0.7) +  
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = AVG - SD, ymax = AVG + SD), alpha = 0.5, size = 0) +
    labs(title = protein,
         x = "Retention time [min]",
         y = "Response [LU]",
         color = "Cell line",
         fill = "Cell line") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 14, hjust = 0.5),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 15),    
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 15),   
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 15),    
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 15),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 16),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 14)
    ) +
    annotate("text", x = t1, y = y_label, label = paste0("T1 = ", t1,"\n"), size = 4, color = "#9e9e9e", angle=90) +
    annotate("text", x = t2, y = y_label, label = paste0("\n","T2 = ", t2), size = 4, color = "#9e9e9e", angle=90) +
    geom_vline(xintercept=t1, linetype="dashed", color="gray", linewidth=0.5) +
    geom_vline(xintercept=t2, linetype="dashed", color="gray", linewidth=0.5) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("#6db550", "#8896c8")) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("#6db550", "#8896c8")) 
  
  print(gg)
  
  dev.off()
  
}
```

# Get GFP info
```{r}
metadata <- read.csv("../data/fSec/fSec_GFP_trip/meta.txt", sep="\t", colClasses = c("file"="character","protein"="character","cell"="character"))
data_path <- "../data/fSec/fSec_GFP_trip/"
out_path <- "../results/fSec/"
baseline_range = 200

protein <- "GFP"
cell <- "GFP_1_1000"

t1_GFP <- 9.605986471
t2_GFP <- 14.00521463

df_GFP <- merge_dfs(metadata, protein, cell, data_path, baseline_range, t1_GFP, t2_GFP)

GFP_AUC <- df_GFP$AUC[1]
GFP_conc <- 4.8
```

```{r}
GFP_AUC
```

# Specify times
```{r}
t1_GPR75 <- 6.30302157
t2_GPR75 <- 9.70144332
t1_GIPR <- 6.205033425
t2_GIPR <- 9.30105324
t1_hP2X3 <- 6.203852175
t2_hP2X3 <- 10.00547651
```

# Get info for data
```{r}
protein <- c("GPR75","GIPR","hP2X3")
cell <- c("Vulko","Expi293")

ix <- get_index(metadata, protein, cell)

temp_lists <- list()

for (i in ix) {
    filepath <- list.files(data_path, pattern = paste0(i, ".dx_FLD1A.CSV$"), full.names = TRUE)
    df <- read.csv(filepath, header=FALSE)
    
    # Read in data + get AUC
    cell_type <- metadata[metadata$file == i, ]$cell
    protein <- metadata[metadata$file == i, ]$protein
    
    if (protein == "GPR75"){AUC <- get_AUC(df, t1_GPR75, t2_GPR75, baseline_range)}
    if (protein == "GIPR"){AUC <- get_AUC(df, t1_GIPR, t2_GIPR, baseline_range)}
    if (protein == "hP2X3"){AUC <- get_AUC(df, t1_hP2X3, t2_hP2X3, baseline_range)}
    
    # Create temp list of values to include
    temp <- list(file = i,
                 protein = protein,
                 cell_type = cell_type,
                 AUC = AUC)
    
    temp_lists[[i]] <- temp
    
}

barplot_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(temp_lists, as.data.frame))

# Convert to concs using GFP: (protein AUC / GFP AUC) * GFP concentration
barplot_df$Concs <- (barplot_df$AUC/GFP_AUC)*GFP_conc

barplot_df
```



Group and do statistical test between groups
```{r}
grouped <- group_by(barplot_df, cell_type, protein)
df_means <- summarise(grouped, mean=mean(Concs), sd=sd(Concs))

stat.test <- barplot_df %>%
            group_by(protein) %>%
            t_test(Concs ~ cell_type)

# Generate LFC
FC_df <- df_means %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = cell_type, values_from = c(mean,sd), names_sep = "_") %>%
  mutate(FC = round((mean_Vulko / mean_Expi293),3))


stat.test <- stat.test %>% left_join(FC_df %>% select(protein, FC), by = "protein") %>%
   mutate(label = paste0("FC ", FC, "\npval ", p))
  

FC_df
stat.test

```
